newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Celesc to launch shares abroad.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Celesc to launch shares abroad.

text.p: Officials at Brazilian power utility Celesc are on a road show in the U.S. to attract investors for an issue of 140 million preferred shares on the domestic and international markets, a company representative said.
A total of 49 million preferred "B" shares will be offered to local investors, while 91 million of Global Depositary Shares (GDS) will be offered to foreigners, the official said.
The resources raised with the share issue will be used to finance investments in expanding Celesc's power generating capacity, he added.
The share price has not been set yet, the official said.
Based in southern Brazil, Celesc is controlled by Santa Catarina state government. It serves 1.4 million customers and provides about 97 percent of electricity consumed in the state.
The road show, which began in Europe and Argentina, ends on September 24 in New York, the official said.
